messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "call your doctor for medical advice about side effects"
set: ["call your doctor for medical advice about side effects", "call your doctor at once if you have side effects", "discuss sexual side effects with your doctor", "call your doctor for instructions", "call doctor right away if serious side effects occur", "stop using and call your doctor at once if serious side effects occur", "tell your doctor if side effects bother you a lot", "tell your doctor if side effects start later in therapy", "tell your doctor if side effects last for more than a few weeks", "treatment options are available for side effects", "call child's doctor about symptoms", "tell your doctor about any unusual or bothersome side effect", "tell doctor about all medical conditions", "call doctor for headache", "call doctor for weakness", "call doctor for jaundice"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "call your doctor at once if you have side effects",
    "call doctor right away if serious side effects occur",
    "stop using and call your doctor at once if serious side effects occur",
    "tell your doctor if side effects bother you a lot",
    "tell your doctor if side effects start later in therapy",
    "tell your doctor if side effects last for more than a few weeks",
    "tell your doctor about any unusual or bothersome side effect"
  ],
  "alias": "call your doctor for medical advice about side effects"
}
